description.purpose: The charter: what the steward shall achieve, what it may do, and every threshold a judge needs to decide -- as ROWS. Goals carry their own measurement window, their minimum sample count and the significance floor below which nothing is done; rules carry the mutation radius, the budget cap and the quality gate.
description.use_when: One per steward hive. A goal is turned on by setting `enabled` to 1 -- a fresh instance ships every row disabled, so a newly grown steward measures nothing and changes nothing until somebody means it.
description.not_in_scope: No history: what happened lives in `receipts`. A charter says what SHALL be, not what WAS.
